question.text: Minimum investment amount per client DOES NOT apply to:

answer.text: Accredited Investors and co-investment portfolio managers

explanation.text: The Logic: Accredited Investors (certified) and co-investment PMs have a carve-out. The Trap: Retail, HUFs, trusts must meet the Rs. 50 lakh minimum. Cross-Exam Context: Accredited Investor framework in XIX-A, XIX-B.
